headline: More information than ever.
Less clarity than ever.
problem.copy: People are surrounded by health advice, supplements, diets, studies, opinions, and trends. Knowing what to actually do with that information can be difficult.
problem.conclusion: The answer isn't more noise. It's knowing where to begin.

matrix.heading: A better way to move forward.
matrix.introduction: You don't need every answer today. You need a process for finding your next one.
matrix.conclusionCopy: A framework for taking a more informed, intentional role in your wellness.

founder.label: Why I built this
founder.heading: I got tired of waiting.
paragraphs: I got tired of relying on other people to make me feel better.
So I decided to get informed about my situation. I started educating myself about what I found, asking better questions, and looking for credible information.
Then came the most important part: taking action.
The Mindful Matrix didn't come from having all the answers. It came from realizing that I didn't have to wait around for them.
I could learn. I could ask questions. I could make changes. I could take the next step.
founder.statement: Nobody is coming to save me but me.
founder.philosophyContext: A personal philosophy about agency—not a replacement for professional healthcare.

testing.copy: Testing is one possible way to become more informed. It is a starting point for asking better questions—not the entire Mindful Matrix philosophy.
